detail.longDescription: Marcin Grabias has written up how Tag1 moved two large union learning platforms onto the new drupal/lms module without stopping them. The risk-management move: in June 2025 the team froze the working 0.2.x code in web/modules/custom/lms/ and required the new contrib package in web/modules/contrib/lms/. Both engines ran in the same codebase and the same database. Read how the in-place migration moved the data across: https://www. tag1.com/blog/rebuilding-lms-m id-flight/ # Drupal # OpenSource # PHP http://0.2.x/
